definitions.explanation: A somewhat formal word for being angered or offended by someone's words or actions. Used as a suru-verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立腹|りっぷく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{無礼|ぶれい}→無礼：15041_burei⟧な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立腹|りっぷく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was offended by the rude attitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悪|わる}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧{立腹|りっぷく}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧ようです。
examples.english: The customer appears to be very upset about the poor service.

notes:
A relatively formal way to express anger. Composed of {立|りつ} (to rise) + {腹|ぷく} (belly/stomach), literally "the stomach rises" — related to the Japanese association of the belly with emotions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立腹|りっぷく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be angered, to take offense
- ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧{立腹|りっぷく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be very angry
- ご{立腹|りっぷく}: your anger (respectful)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧: anger — the most general word for anger
- ⟦{憤慨|ふんがい}→憤慨：06436_fungai⟧: indignation — anger at something perceived as unjust
- ⟦{激怒|げきど}→激怒：08681_gekido⟧: fury, rage — much stronger intensity

REGISTER:
{立腹|りっぷく} is more formal and restrained than ⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧. It often appears in business or formal contexts, especially in the respectful form ご{立腹|りっぷく}.
